verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL is documented as running directly on the data lake with ANSI SQL plus Delta Lake extensions, building warehouses "without moving your data". Delta time travel queries are also documented, and community comments confirm Delta is Databricks' core open format. However, the evidence never mentions querying Iceberg or raw Parquet files. One user also reports that Unity Catalog only mounts external volumes matching the workspace's cloud provider, which limits cross-cloud object-storage access. Missing for 10: evidence of Iceberg support, evidence of direct Parquet/file querying, cross-cloud object storage access, and independent hands-on corroboration.
